display_name: Marius of Persia, husband of Martha

names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 6 iulie, «Sfinții Mucenici Marius și Marta, soția sa, și fiii lor Audifaciu și Avacum».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 6. јул ст. ст., „Св. муч. Марин и Марта,“ — Св. is not a rank and муч. is the rank, which `types` already carries; both come off, „и Марта“ is the other name the heading enumerates, and the bare forename is left. «of Persia, husband of Martha» in the display name is the corpus’s own disambiguation off doxologia and is not in this heading. **The form is this book’s own, „Марин“, against doxologia’s Latin «Marius» which the slug and display name follow, and it is copied as printed and not conformed to either.** `foldchk.py` returns `marinus-martyr-17-march`, `sr`, for «Марин», so this is the second folder on the string and the heading offers nothing to break it with.

The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 1455, «Марин Персиянин, Римский, мч.», with the rank word after the last comma left off. The day line gives the bare forename in the genitive, «Марина». `fk.mjs` returns no other holder.

death.note: Two books, two years one apart, and the field is widened rather than chosen — and the note records which year is stated and which is reasoned. doxologia.ro reasons from the names in the account: «Deoarece în istorisirea din Viețile Sfinților sunt amintiți Episcopul Calist al Romei (217-222) și Împăratul Claudiu al II-lea Goticul (268-270), se înțelege că venirea la Roma a celor patru sfinți a fost în jurul anului 220, iar moartea lor mucenicească prin anul 270.» The same page puts their birth «la începutul veacului al III-lea», which this folder has never carried and does not carry now. The Охридски пролог for 6. јул ст. ст. states one year flat: „Сви пострадаше у време цара Клаудија Флавија у Риму, 269 год.“ — all suffered in the time of the emperor Claudius Flavius at Rome, in the year 269. The emperor both books name is the same man and is no source for either year. Nothing is averaged and neither book is preferred (5 October 2026).

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 июля ст. ст. — «Мчч. Марина , Марфы , Авдифакса , @2[Аввакума], Кирина , Валентина пресвитера, Астерия и иных многих в Риме (269).»

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, first name, and this folder’s man: the same menologion day its Romanian and Serbian rows already keep, the same company of four Persians at Rome, the same emperor. The line is quoted exactly as the page prints it: the fourth name stands in the source’s own HTML as «@2[Аввакума]», an unresolved name-link template, which is why Аввакум alone of the seven carries no `/name/` link. The artefact is the page’s and not the scrape’s — it is in the cached HTML itself. The reading life4166 was opened. The Russian line and reading put the company at Rome under Claudius II (268–270) and close with 269, which falls inside the interval this folder already carries; `dates` UNCHANGED. The two names of the seven that the corpus did not hold — Кирин and Астерий — are new folders in this same batch, `cyrinus-companion-of-marius` and `asterius-of-rome`, and the whole company is joined by `related`. «иных многих» names nobody and takes no folder. Name page 1455 heads him «Марин Персиянин, Римский, мч.» and lists «День памяти: 6 июля» and no other day.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 19.07.2026 (6. јул ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Марин и Марта,“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry, the first of the two names its heading enumerates. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, as every heading of this wave is — and this day one of them ends in a comma, which is kept. The Julian 6 July is the same menologion number this folder’s Romanian row carries, its only other venerated row, so there is no second day and no §4 note is owed. **A WIDENED DATE, AND THE BOOK THAT IS WIDENED AGAINST REACHED ITS YEAR BY ARITHMETIC.** The folder held `death` 270 to 270, display «c. 270», off doxologia’s own reasoning: «Deoarece în istorisirea din Viețile Sfinților sunt amintiți Episcopul Calist al Romei (217-222) și Împăratul Claudiu al II-lea Goticul (268-270), se înțelege că venirea la Roma a celor patru sfinți a fost în jurul anului 220, iar moartea lor mucenicească prin anul 270» — two reigns, and a year inferred from where they overlap. This book **states** one: „Сви пострадаше у време цара Клаудија Флавија у Риму, 269 год.“ — all suffered in the time of the emperor Claudius Flavius at Rome, in the year 269. One year apart, and the rule widens and does not choose: `death` earliest 269, latest 270, display «269 or about 270», basis traditional, both sentences in the note. **Neither is preferred, and the note says plainly which is stated and which is reasoned** — this corpus would not itself derive a year from two reigns, and the derivation is doxologia’s and is left standing as that page’s reading rather than corrected. The emperor this book names is the same Claudius, and **he is no source for either year**. The `birth` doxologia puts «la începutul veacului al III-lea» was never written into this folder and is not written now. WHAT IS NEW, AND THE ANSWER IS THE BEST OF IT. That they were rich people out of Persia who **sold everything they had in Persia** and came to Rome with their sons to venerate the relics of the holy apostles and of the other martyrs. And that when the emperor asked them why they had come from such a distance, leaving their own household gods, to seek dead men at Rome, they answered: „ми смо слуге Христове, и дођосмо да се поклонимо светим апостолима, чије бесмртне душе живе с Богом, да би они били наши молитвеници пред Христом Богом нашим“ — we are servants of Christ, and we came to venerate the holy apostles, whose immortal souls live with God, that they might be our intercessors before Christ our God. Neither other book has the question or the answer. `types` UNTOUCHED: `martyr` is there and „Св. муч.“ is the `martyr`; Свети is not a rank, and «rich people out of Persia» is not one either. No `office`, no `locations`: Persia, Rome and the Tiber in a narrative are not coordinates. **NO NEW ROWS.** The folder already relates `martha-wife-of-marius`, `audifax-son-of-marius` and `abachum-son-of-marius`, which is every person of this company the corpus holds, and all three rows exist in both directions already. **THE COMPANY, THE COMMA, AND FOUR FOLDERS THAT STAND ON THIS NUMBER AND GET NO ROW.** The heading is „Св. муч. Марин и Марта,“ — it ends in a **comma**, and the body picks the sentence up: „са синовима Авдифаксом и Авакумом, свештеником Валентином, Кирином, Астеријем и многим другим“, with their sons Audifax and Abachum, the presbyter Valentine, Quirinus, Asterius and many others. §5 says count what the **heading** enumerates, and the heading enumerates **two**: Marin and Marta. So this entry is two rows and the body’s five named companions get none. **This is the 18 June ruling at its most expensive yet.** `audifax-son-of-marius` and `abachum-son-of-marius` both exist, both are `martyr`, both are kept **venerated by the Romanian calendar on the Julian 6 July — the same number these two rows are written on** — and both are **already related by both parents’ folders**, so the relation is not what is missing. What is refused is a `serbian` attestation row quoted off a heading that does not carry them. Valentine, Quirinus and Asterius are the same refusal with the identification unmade besides: `ls saints | grep -i valentine` returns five, of whom `valentine-of-rome` is kept on 14 February and `valentine-of-interamna` on 30 July and 14 February, and **an identification made off a name in another man’s life is not an identification**; the corpus holds no Quirinus of this account, and thirty-odd folders carry Asterius. „и многим другим“, and many others, names nobody at all, and a narrated martyrdom with no name gets no row and no folder. **AND THE SCENES THOSE NAMES CARRY ARE STILL WORTH THE LIFE.** Quirinus was thrown into the Tiber and **Marin and Marta drew his body out and buried it honourably** — which is their own act and goes into both their lives. Valentine the presbyter was handed over to a commander Asterius to be talked into denying Christ, and instead healed Asterius’s daughter, blind two years, by prayer, and then baptised Asterius and his whole house. That is **not** their act and is written as the entry’s, in the one sentence that makes clear whose story it is. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse. **THE DAY’S THIRD ENTRY IS A FEAST AND IS REFUSED TWICE OVER.** „Обретеније моштију св. Јулијаније девице“ — the finding of the relics of the holy virgin Juliana. §5 is explicit that an «Обретење моштију» is a feast and not a folder, which is the first refusal; **and no folder holds her**, which is the second. The entry says she was the daughter of the prince of Olshansk, died about 1540 a virgin of sixteen, and that two hundred years after her death the diggers of a new grave beside the great church of the Kyiv lavra came on her relics whole and incorrupt, as though she had only just fallen asleep; many wonders came of them, and she herself appeared more than once to individual persons. `ls saints | grep -i juliana` returns seven and **not one of them is she**: `juliana-4-december`, `juliana-mother-of-saturninus`, `juliana-of-amisos`, `juliana-of-lazarevo`, `juliana-of-nicomedia`, `juliana-of-ptolemais` and `juliana-of-rhosus`. `ls saints | grep -i olshan` holds nobody. `foldchk.py` returns NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM for «Јулијанија». Ruling 3: named here, left out of every life written on this day, and no folder from me — and **the year 1540, the sixteen years, and the two hundred years are written nowhere**, the first being hedged „около“ in any case and the other two being durations. **AND THE ONE MAN IN THAT ENTRY WHO DOES HAVE A FOLDER TAKES NO ROW.** „знаменити Петар Могила“ — the famous Peter Mohyla — had one of those visions of her, and `peter-mohyla` is a folder kept venerated by the Romanian calendar on 22 December. An appearance is not a relation, which is the Three Hierarchs ruling; the entry is a feast, so no row of any kind hangs on it; and the folder it would hang on is Juliana’s, which does not exist.

hymns.text: Ca niște stele strălucitoare ați călătorit din Persia, țara celor trei magi, de la Răsărit până la Apus, în Roma cea veche, râvnind să cinstiți pe stelele Soarelui Dreptății Celui răsărit în Betleem și să vă închinați la moaștele Sfinților Apostoli Petru și Pavel și ale altor Sfinți Mărturisitori. O, iubitorilor de mucenici, Marius și Marta cu fiii Audifaciu și Avacum, prin pătimiri mucenicești adăugându-vă lor, mijlociți pentru noi iertare de păcate, pace și mare milă.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Marius, soția sa Marta și fiii lor Audifaciu și Avacum», Glas 5

english.text: Like shining stars you journeyed out of Persia, the land of the three magi, from the East as far as the West, to old Rome, longing to honour the stars of the Sun of Righteousness who rose in Bethlehem, and to venerate the relics of the holy apostles Peter and Paul and of the other holy confessors. O lovers of the martyrs, Marius and Martha with your sons Audifax and Abachum, who by a martyr's sufferings were added to their number: intercede for us, for the forgiveness of sins, for peace and for great mercy.
